__NOTOC__
<quote by="Proposed: Fedelmidd Sydanjaa's Heart Floer, Senator for Sermersuaq, Seconded: Mel Bleak, Senator for Mournwold">To construct the Atalaq Tradehall, a great work in Sealtoq to help the investment of businesses in Sermersuaq. 50 weirwood, 150 crowns. Lapses this season. Seeking funds.
</quote>
==Overview==
* Constructs a [[great work]] in Sealtoq, Sermersuaq
*The tradehall was most recently suggested as part of the [[The_circle_game#Fish_and_Fur_in_Sermersuaq|appraisal]] to identify alternate trades that ministries could make that would not involve paying coin. The appraisal diverted slightly into previous opportunities to increase the funds flowing into the Anvil economy.
* Passed

==Date==
* Autumn 388YE

==Cost==
* Costs as per opportunity
* 50 wains of weirwood
* 150 crowns in labour costs
* Three months to complete

==Progress==
{{CommissionProgress|Construct_Atalaq_Tradehall}}
==Outcome==
Once complete, the Atalaq Tradehall will have the following effects:
* Increases investment in businesses in Sermersuaq by one.
* Increase taxation from Sermersuaq by 4 thrones.
* Increases the income of the [[Custodian of the Bloody Great Sausage]] by 7 crowns
* Boosts income of Wintermark fleet owners by 36 rings for one year whenever they engage in trade with foreign nations
